:::{#def-term-vector}
#### Term vector

Consider a model whose mean is a linear combination
of $\nparams$ terms $\termfn{1}(\predvar), \ldots, \termfn{\nparams}(\predvar)$ of the covariate value,
such as $1$, $\predvar$ and $\predvar^2$.
The **term vector** $\termvec{\iobs}$ of observation $\iobs$
is the column of its terms:

$$
\termvec{\iobs} \eqdef \tp{\paren{\termfn{1}(\predvar_{\iobs}), \ldots, \termfn{\nparams}(\predvar_{\iobs})}}.
$$ {#eq-term-vector}

:::
